ny-sboe-2026-general-cert.agency: New York State Board of Elections
ny-sboe-2026-general-cert.title: Certification for the November 3, 2026 General Election (amended, 2026-09-17): state offices
ny-sboe-2026-general-cert.note: Listed on https://elections.ny.gov/ballot-certifications-elections; the same file the federal loader reads (136 pages). Read: Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Comptroller, Attorney General, all 63 State Senate and 150 Assembly seats, and Justice of the Supreme Court in 11 judicial districts (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13); 26 congressional tables are left to the federal pages. Only the office, district, counties, seats, party and name cells are read; the file prints no contact details. Several parties may nominate one candidate (fusion): 287 candidates hold more than one line, and 293 party lines are printed with no candidate. Ballot order is the order of each candidate's first line on the list. The counties each district reaches are the certification's own "Counties" lines.

ny-openstates-roster.title: Sitting New York legislators and statewide officials
ny-openstates-roster.note: Who holds each seat today, and which candidate is a sitting member (same chamber and district, the name or one of the roster's other spellings fits, one fit only). The roster's statewide officials are the Governor, Lieutenant Governor and Attorney General; it carries no Comptroller and no judges. Ids, names, party, chamber and district only.

ny-census-counties-2024.title: Cartographic boundary file, counties, 2024 (1:500,000)
ny-census-counties-2024.note: Five-digit county codes (GEOID) for New York's 62 counties, matched by name to the certification's "Counties" lines.

ny-sboe-2026-primary-results.agency: New York State Board of Elections
ny-sboe-2026-primary-results.title: June 23, 2026 Primary Election: vote results (2026-june-primary-vote-results-08312026.xlsx): state offices
ny-sboe-2026-primary-results.note: Linked from https://elections.ny.gov/certified-june-23-2026-primary-election-results; the copy saved in ballot_cache/ny/ (elections.ny.gov answers scripts with a Cloudflare challenge), the same file the federal loader reads. 64 state contests read (Comptroller, State Senate, Assembly); 20 congressional sheets are the federal loader's and 39 sheets for judicial delegates and state committee members (party positions, not offices) are left alone. Did not add up: SH71 DEM, Al Taylor (DEM): Total Votes by Candidate says 14,777, Total Votes by Party 9,174 (the party's figure, which the county cells add up to, is used); SH71 DEM, Rolando Gomez (DEM): Total Votes by Candidate says 3,143, Total Votes by Party 1,634 (the party's figure, which the county cells add up to, is used). Shares are of the candidates' votes plus write-ins (Scattering); blank and void ballots are left out. The most votes wins a New York primary (no runoffs). The workbook carries names and votes only. Contests with one name on the ballot (no field): 2026-NY-SS38 WOR.
